tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_archive_chat
tool_signatures.description: Archive or unarchive a chat. Archiving only hides it from the main list on this account; messages are kept and it can be undone. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_block_contact
tool_signatures.description: Block a contact by user JID: they can no longer message or call this number, and they are not notified. Reversible with whatsapp_unblock_contact. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_bulk_check_users
tool_signatures.description: Check many phone numbers at once for WhatsApp accounts. Read-only. Pass numbers with country code, digits only. Returns whether each number is registered, with its user JID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_check_user
tool_signatures.description: Check whether one phone number has WhatsApp, before sending to it. Read-only. Pass the number with country code, digits only. Returns whether it is registered and its user JID. For many numbers at once, use whatsapp_bulk_check_users.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_clear_chat
tool_signatures.description: Delete all messages in a chat on this account but keep the chat in the list. It cannot be undone and does not affect other participants. To remove the chat entirely, use whatsapp_delete_chat. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_create_community
tool_signatures.description: Create a new WhatsApp community with this number as its admin, optionally adding participants. Participants are added immediately and notified. Returns the new community JID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_create_community_group
tool_signatures.description: Create a new group inside a community, optionally with participants, who are added and notified. Requires community admin rights. To attach a group that already exists, use whatsapp_link_group_to_community. Returns the new group JID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_create_contact
tool_signatures.description: Save a contact on the connected number, or update its name if it already exists. Only affects this account

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_create_group
tool_signatures.description: Create a new group with this number as admin and the given participants (user JIDs). Participants are added immediately and notified. Calling it twice creates two groups. Returns the new group JID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_create_newsletter
tool_signatures.description: Create a new WhatsApp channel (newsletter) owned by this number, with a name and optional description and picture. It is public once created. Returns the new channel JID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_delete_chat
tool_signatures.description: Delete a whole chat and its messages from this account. It cannot be undone, and it only affects this account: the other participants keep their copy. To empty a chat but keep it in the list, use whatsapp_clear_chat. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_delete_message
tool_signatures.description: Delete a message for everyone in the chat. It cannot be undone; participants see that a message was deleted. Only works on messages this number sent (or, as group admin, on others

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_delete_message_for_me
tool_signatures.description: Delete a message only on this account. Other participants still see it. It cannot be undone. To remove it for everyone, use whatsapp_delete_message. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_delete_status
tool_signatures.description: Delete a status this number posted, by its message ID. Contacts stop seeing it. It cannot be undone. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_download_media
tool_signatures.description: Download the file attached to a received message, using media.id from the message event. Read-only. Returns the file as binary content, with its MIME type.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_edit_message
tool_signatures.description: Edit the text of a message this number sent. Everyone in the chat sees it marked as edited. WhatsApp only allows it for about 15 minutes after sending. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_flush_history
tool_signatures.description: Re-publish the history sync messages cached for this instance as events. It does not return messages: they arrive later through the event stream. Returns an acknowledgement.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_blocklist
tool_signatures.description: List the contacts this number has blocked. Read-only. To change it, use whatsapp_block_contact or whatsapp_unblock_contact. Returns the blocked JIDs.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_chat
tool_signatures.description: Get the details of one chat by its JID: name, unread state, and settings such as mute, pin, archive and disappearing timer. Read-only. Returns the chat object.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_chat_business_profile
tool_signatures.description: Get the WhatsApp Business profile of a chat: description, category, website, email and address. Read-only. Only business accounts have one. Returns the profile object.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_chat_picture
tool_signatures.description: Get the profile picture of a chat (a contact or a group) by its JID. Read-only. Returns the picture URL and ID; fails if the chat has no picture or it is hidden by privacy settings.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_chats
tool_signatures.description: List every chat on the connected number, both direct and group. Read-only. Use this to discover chat JIDs; use whatsapp_get_chat for one chat

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_community
tool_signatures.description: Get the details of a community by its JID: name, description, settings and announcement group. Read-only. Returns the community object.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_community_invite_link
tool_signatures.description: Get the current invite link of a community. Requires admin rights. Anyone with the link can ask to join. Returns the link.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_community_participants
tool_signatures.description: List the participants of a community, with their admin status. Read-only. Returns the participants.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_community_sub_groups
tool_signatures.description: List the groups linked to a community. Read-only. Returns the groups and their JIDs.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_contact
tool_signatures.description: Get one saved contact by JID: saved name, push name and business name. Read-only. Returns the contact object.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_contacts
tool_signatures.description: List the contacts saved on the connected number. Read-only. To check whether a phone number has WhatsApp, use whatsapp_check_user. Returns the contacts and their count.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_group
tool_signatures.description: Get the details of a group by JID: name, description, settings and participants. Read-only. Returns the group object.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_group_info_from_link
tool_signatures.description: Preview a group from an invite code without joining it: name, description and size. Read-only. Returns the group info.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_group_invite_link
tool_signatures.description: Get the current invite link of a group. Requires admin rights. Anyone with the link can join. Returns the link.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_group_participants
tool_signatures.description: List a group

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_group_requests
tool_signatures.description: List the pending requests to join a group that has join approval on. Requires admin rights. Read-only. Returns the requesting user JIDs.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_groups
tool_signatures.description: List the groups the connected number belongs to. Read-only. Use this to find group JIDs (ending in @g.us). Returns the groups and their count.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_my_profile
tool_signatures.description: Get the connected number

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_newsletter
tool_signatures.description: Get a channel

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_newsletter_by_invite
tool_signatures.description: Look up a channel by its invite code, without following it. Read-only. Returns the channel info and JID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_pair_code
tool_signatures.description: Get an 8-character pairing code for a phone number, to link it without scanning a QR (WhatsApp, Linked devices, Link with phone number). Only works while logged out. Returns the code.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_privacy_settings
tool_signatures.description: Get the account

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_qr_code
tool_signatures.description: Get the login QR code as a text string, to pair a phone with this instance. Only works while logged out, and each code expires within about a minute. For an image, use whatsapp_get_qr_code_image; to pair by phone number, use whatsapp_get_pair_code. Returns the QR string.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_qr_code_image
tool_signatures.description: Get the login QR code as a PNG image, to scan from WhatsApp on the phone (Linked devices). Only works while logged out, and each code expires within about a minute. Returns the image.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_session_status
tool_signatures.description: Check whether the WhatsApp session is connected and logged in. Read-only. Call it first when other tools fail, to tell a logged-out session from another error. Returns the connection and login state.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_status_privacy
tool_signatures.description: Get who can see this number

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_get_user_profile
tool_signatures.description: Get another user

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_join_group_with_invite
tool_signatures.description: Accept a group invite that was received as a direct message (not a link), using the fields from that invite message. Other participants see this number join. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_join_group_with_link
tool_signatures.description: Join a group using the code from an invite link (chat.whatsapp.com/<code>). Other participants see this number join. To preview the group first, use whatsapp_get_group_info_from_link. Returns the joined group JID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_leave_community
tool_signatures.description: Leave a community and all its groups. Other members are notified, and rejoining needs a new invite. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_leave_group
tool_signatures.description: Leave a group. Other participants are notified, and rejoining needs a new invite. If this number is the only admin, WhatsApp picks another one. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_link_group_to_community
tool_signatures.description: Attach an existing group to a community. Requires admin rights in both. Group members become part of the community. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_list_communities
tool_signatures.description: List the communities the connected number belongs to. Read-only. Returns the communities and their JIDs.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_list_newsletters
tool_signatures.description: List the channels (newsletters) this number follows or owns. Read-only. Returns the channels and their JIDs.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_logout
tool_signatures.description: Log this instance out of WhatsApp and unlink it from the phone. Every other tool stops working until the number is paired again with a QR or pair code. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_mark_chat_as_read
tool_signatures.description: Mark a whole chat as read or unread on this account. To send a read receipt for one message, use whatsapp_mark_message_read. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_mark_message_read
tool_signatures.description: Send a read receipt for a message, so the sender sees it as read (blue ticks, if their privacy settings allow). To mark a whole chat, use whatsapp_mark_chat_as_read. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_mute_chat
tool_signatures.description: Mute a chat

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_mute_newsletter
tool_signatures.description: Mute or unmute a channel

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_pin_chat
tool_signatures.description: Pin a chat to the top of the chat list, or unpin it. Only affects this account. To pin a message inside a chat, use whatsapp_pin_message. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_pin_message
tool_signatures.description: Pin or unpin a message in a chat, optionally for a limited time. Everyone in the chat sees the pin. To pin a whole chat in the list, use whatsapp_pin_chat. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_post_image_status
tool_signatures.description: Post an image status (story) from base64 data or a public URL, with an optional caption, visible to allowed contacts for 24 hours. Not idempotent. Returns the status message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_post_text_status
tool_signatures.description: Post a text status (story), visible to contacts allowed by the status privacy settings for 24 hours. Not idempotent. Returns the status message ID, which whatsapp_delete_status needs.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_post_video_status
tool_signatures.description: Post a video status (story) from base64 data or a public URL, with an optional caption, visible to allowed contacts for 24 hours. Not idempotent. Returns the status message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_reject_call
tool_signatures.description: Reject an incoming WhatsApp call, using the callId and callerId from the call_offer event. The caller sees the call as declined. Only works while the call is still ringing. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_request_chat_messages
tool_signatures.description: Ask WhatsApp for older messages of a chat, starting before a given message. It does not return messages: they arrive later as history sync events, if the phone provides them. Returns an acknowledgement only.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_reset_community_invite_link
tool_signatures.description: Revoke a community

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_reset_group_invite_link
tool_signatures.description: Revoke a group

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_audio
tool_signatures.description: Send an audio file as a regular audio attachment, from base64 data or a public URL. For a voice note that plays like a recorded message, use whatsapp_send_voice. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_contact
tool_signatures.description: Send a contact card, either from a display name or a full vCard. The recipient can save it to their address book. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_document
tool_signatures.description: Send a file as a document, from base64 data or a public URL, with a required filename and optional caption. Use it for PDFs and any file that should not be shown inline as media. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_image
tool_signatures.description: Send an image, from base64 data or a public URL, with an optional caption, to a user or group JID. The recipient receives it immediately; set viewOnce for a view-once image. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_link
tool_signatures.description: Send a text message with a link preview (title, description and thumbnail). Use it instead of whatsapp_send_text when you want to control how the preview looks. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_location
tool_signatures.description: Send a map location by latitude and longitude, with an optional place name and address. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_reaction
tool_signatures.description: React to a message with an emoji, or remove this number

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_sticker
tool_signatures.description: Send a sticker in WebP format, from base64 data or a public URL. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_text
tool_signatures.description: Send a text message to a user JID or a group JID (<id>@g.us). The recipient receives it immediately and it cannot be unsent, only deleted with whatsapp_delete_message. Supports mentions, replies and a disappearing timer. Not idempotent: calling it twice sends two messages. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_video
tool_signatures.description: Send a video, from base64 data or a public URL, with an optional caption, to a user or group JID. The recipient receives it immediately. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_send_voice
tool_signatures.description: Send a voice note (push-to-talk), from base64 data or a public URL; OGG/Opus plays best. It appears as a recorded voice message. For a music or audio file, use whatsapp_send_audio. Not idempotent. Returns the message ID.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_chat_ephemeral
tool_signatures.description: Set the disappearing messages timer for a chat (off, 24 hours, 7 days or 90 days). All participants see the change and new messages follow it. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_chat_presence
tool_signatures.description: Show a typing or recording indicator in a chat, or clear it with paused. The other side sees it in real time. Use it just before sending a reply; it does not send anything by itself. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_community_description
tool_signatures.description: Change a community

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_community_locked
tool_signatures.description: Turn locked mode on or off for a community. When on, only admins can edit the community

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_community_name
tool_signatures.description: Rename a community. Requires admin rights; all members see the change. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_community_picture
tool_signatures.description: Set a community

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_group_announce
tool_signatures.description: Turn announcement mode on or off. When on, only admins can send messages in the group. Requires admin rights. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_group_join_approval
tool_signatures.description: Turn join approval on or off. When on, people joining by link need an admin to approve them (see whatsapp_get_group_requests). Requires admin rights. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_group_locked
tool_signatures.description: Turn locked mode on or off. When on, only admins can edit the group

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_group_member_add_mode
tool_signatures.description: Choose whether only admins or all members can add participants to a group. Requires admin rights. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_group_picture
tool_signatures.description: Set a group

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_newsletter_subscription
tool_signatures.description: Follow or unfollow a channel by JID. Following adds its updates to this account; the channel owner only sees the follower count. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_presence
tool_signatures.description: Set this account as available or unavailable. Available makes it show online to contacts; for a typing indicator in one chat, use whatsapp_set_chat_presence. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_set_privacy_setting
tool_signatures.description: Change one privacy setting of the account, for example who can see the profile picture. Applies immediately to all contacts. Returns the updated settings.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_star_message
tool_signatures.description: Star or unstar a message on this account. Only this account sees it. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_subscribe_chat_presence
tool_signatures.description: Subscribe to a contact

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_sync_contacts
tool_signatures.description: Re-sync the address book from the WhatsApp servers. Use it when whatsapp_get_contacts looks outdated. It runs in the background. Returns an acknowledgement, not the contacts.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_unblock_contact
tool_signatures.description: Unblock a previously blocked contact, so they can message and call this number again. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_unlink_community_group
tool_signatures.description: Detach a group from a community. The group keeps existing on its own, but its members lose access to the community through it. Requires admin rights. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_update_community_participants
tool_signatures.description: Add, remove, promote to admin or demote participants of a community, by user JID. Requires admin rights. Removed participants lose access and everyone affected is notified. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_update_group_description
tool_signatures.description: Change a group

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_update_group_name
tool_signatures.description: Rename a group. All participants see the change; it may require admin rights if the group is locked. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_update_group_participants
tool_signatures.description: Add, remove, promote to admin or demote participants of a group, by user JID. Requires admin rights. Removed participants lose access and everyone affected is notified. Some adds can fail silently because of the invitee

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_update_group_requests
tool_signatures.description: Approve or reject pending join requests for a group, by user JID. Approved users become participants immediately. Requires admin rights. Returns a success confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: whatsapp_update_my_profile
tool_signatures.description: Change the connected number
